facts.raw_span: no specific ocular symptoms
no history of eye surgery
lipid and glucose levels within normal range
Best spectacle-corrected visual acuity: 20/20 OU
Normal conjunctiva with healthy ocular adnexa
4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in posterior corneal stroma
Ring characteristics: Complete rings, outermost ring ~4mm from limbus
Ring measurements (vertical diameters from periphery to center): 6.0mm, 4.8mm, 4.5mm, and 3.6mm
Surface of rings: smooth without obvious deposits, pigmentation, or serrations
Normal corneal sensations bilaterally
Keratometry readings: 43.4 × 43.4 D OD and 43.0 × 44.8 D OS
Serum copper levels: Normal

concepts.why: The patient has 4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in the posterior corneal stroma, with smooth surfaces and no obvious deposits or pigmentation.
The patient has posterior crocodile shagreen, a condition characterized by a roughened corneal surface.
The patient has mild nuclear sclerosis of the crystalline lens, a common age-related condition.
The patient has a small nasal pterygium, a growth on the conjunctiva.
The patient has normal corneal sensations, indicating no significant damage to the corneal nerves.
The patient has a normal conjunctiva, with no signs of inflammation or infection.
The patient has normal serum copper levels, which helps to rule out certain systemic diseases.
The patient has normal serum iron levels, which helps to rule out certain systemic diseases.

rationales.F04: Normal visual acuity suggests no significant corneal or lens pathology.
rationales.F05: Normal conjunctiva and adnexa reduce the likelihood of external eye diseases.
rationales.F06: Concentric ring-shaped opacities are characteristic of corneal ring opacities.
rationales.F07: Complete rings with specific measurements are diagnostic for corneal ring opacities.
rationales.F08: Ring measurements confirm the diagnosis of corneal ring opacities.
rationales.F09: Smooth ring surfaces without deposits or pigmentation support the diagnosis of corneal ring opacities.
rationales.F12: Normal serum copper levels are expected in healthy individuals and some corneal conditions.
